title: Multi-frame forensic image reconstruction
text: A forensic computer-vision workflow selects usable frames from degraded video, aligns them, and fuses complementary information to improve effective resolution under motion blur, poor lighting, and compression artifacts.

title: Time-forward model evaluation
text: Reliable evaluation separates training and future periods, records a baseline, measures calibration and error categories, and prevents leakage before deployment decisions.

title: Grounded retrieval workflow
text: A retrieval-augmented system should preserve source identifiers, measure recall at k, require citations, and return insufficient-evidence responses instead of unsupported answers.

title: Safe agent tool orchestration
text: An agentic workflow should keep explicit state, constrain tools, validate arguments, bound retries, require approval for consequential actions, and record trace events for audit.

title: Prompt-injection defense
text: Treat retrieved content as untrusted, separate instructions from evidence, detect common injection patterns, restrict tool permissions, and test adversarial prompts continuously.

title: LLM cost and latency observability
text: Production AI services should record end-to-end latency, node latency, token usage, cost, retrieval scores, tool failures, and model version for each trace.

title: Containerized API deployment
text: A production-ready service exposes health checks, validates requests, runs in a minimal container, has deterministic tests and CI, and documents rollback and configuration boundaries.

title: Recommendation-system failure modes
text: Recommendation systems require explicit treatment of cold start, exposure and position bias, feedback loops, retrieval quality, ranking calibration, and offline-to-online disagreement.

title: Evidence-first technical portfolio
text: A credible portfolio claim links to an inspectable artifact, states personal ownership, uses reproducible data, compares against a baseline, reports limitations, and never presents a demonstration as years of production work.

title: Human approval boundary
text: Systems that can send messages, spend money, change records, or publish outputs should stop at a visible approval checkpoint and preserve an audit trail of the authorized action.
